up: Return the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513221. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard activity value, standard units, and standard relation. Use the assay_chembl_id column from the assays table to identify the assay.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513221'
